assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the '### Environment / Version' section (line 37) extracts the vague text verbatim: 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' (line 39).

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, Step 4.5.2 (lines 9-21) scans for explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, and version keywords -- all reported as 'none found'. It concludes: 'The section contains only vague text ("Not sure which version", "whatever is deployed on staging"). No version pattern can be extracted.' and 'Result: No version identifier could be determined.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, Step 4.5.6 (lines 36-89) outputs the gap comment. The ADF-format comment at line 56 contains the exact text: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description \u2014 please set manually.' (using an em dash). The plain-text preview at line 41 uses '--' but the actual ADF output matches the required em dash form.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the ADF-format gap comment (lines 58-89) includes a rule separator followed by a footnote paragraph: 'This comment was AI-generated by sdlc-workflow/triage-bug v0.13.10.' where 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' is a hyperlink to 'https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins'.
